summary: Sprint S4 backend verification: bifurcation Household/Commerce + public commerce visibility. Created /app/backend/tests/test_s4_bifurcation.py with 19 tests covering /api/commerces, /api/addresses include_public_commerces toggle, survey_type propagation to is_commerce on addresses, household privacy isolation between owners, direct POST is_commerce=true publicity, and regression checks (health, mock OTP, OTP rate-limit 3/10min, haversine verify, sync bulk, CSV/JSON exports). Ran both new S4 suite AND legacy test_efyl_api.py — 33/33 PASSED, no regressions. Public commerces correctly leak across owners; households remain private. Twilio is disabled (mock OTP=123456) as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/surveys uses update_many on addresses collection to flip is_commerce — this flips ALL addresses sharing the same address_id across owners. Acceptable today because address_id is also part of upsert with owner_id, but cross-owner uniqueness of address_id is not enforced; consider scoping the update to {address_id, owner_id} to avoid unintended cross-owner mutations if multiple owners ever record the same address_id.

GET /api/addresses with include_public_commerces=True executes 2 queries with limit(500) each. For larger datasets this should be unified into a single aggregation with $or to avoid duplicate work and 1000-row ceiling.
server.py is 657 lines — close to the 700-line limit. Consider splitting routes (auth, addresses, surveys, exports) into separate modules in a future sprint.
seed_data_creation: Per-run unique test data created and cleaned up via module-scoped fixture: 4 addresses (userA_<rid> household + commerce-via-survey + direct-commerce, userB_<rid> household). All deleted on teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint S4 backend (bifurcation + public commerces) verified end-to-end. test_s4_bifurcation.py is the canonical regression suite for S4 — reuse it. Key fixtures: USER_A, USER_B and 4 address IDs are generated with a run-id suffix so tests are idempotent. All survey-driven and direct commerce paths are covered. Twilio remains in mock mode. If a future sprint introduces multi-owner duplicate address_ids, revisit the update_many in POST /api/surveys (see critical_code_review_comments).
